decisions.reason: It survived its first year with a dedicated web presence and fits the firm's core dental thermoforming offering, so its option value remains higher than its likely low carrying cost.
This PETG thermoforming blank is close to the firm's established materials and laboratory workflows, and continued standalone presentation suggests enough unresolved upside to justify retaining it.
